title: Gurugram court sentences IAF veteran to 4 months in jail for calling former Deputy Army Chief ‘coward’
description: A court in Gurugram recently sentenced retired Indian Air Force Group Captain Vinod K Gandhi to four months' imprisonment in a defamation case for calling retired Lt. Gen. Raj Kadyan a "coward" in connection with the agitation for One Rank One Pension of defence personnel at Jantar Mantar.Judicial Magistrate Hari Kishan said branding a decorated Army Officer as a “coward”, particularly in communications circulated among veterans and defence personnel, is per se defamatory and reasonably cap
